In the real code the claimed revision must equal the new snapshot revision, so a second round always has a new snapshot and a different recheck row. With the mock, the unique constraint (rework, snapshot) fires and the request ends as a DB error. This looks like a probe assumption (mock reuses snapshot), not a defect in #243. It touches B's #242 code, not changed by this branch. Not fixed, probe not edited. A routed frame lives on the FINAL run's FrameReview; origin frames stay awaiting_followup. UI/queue consumers that only look at the origin run will not see it.
